findings.title: Ollama 0.30.6 is older than 0.34.0
lines: AgentHandover's models need Ollama 0.34.0 or later; http://localhost:11434 answers with 0.30.6.
Homebrew 0.34.2 is installed, but Ollama.app 0.30.6 (pid 812, /Applications/Ollama.app/Contents/Resources/ollama) is serving port 11434.

Fix: To keep Homebrew 0.34.2: quit Ollama.app (menu bar icon > Quit), remove it from System Settings > General > Login Items and move /Applications/Ollama.app to the Trash; then brew services restart ollama.

findings.title: Ollama is installed 2 times
lines: Started at login by homebrew.mxcl.ollama (/Users/me/Library/LaunchAgents/homebrew.mxcl.ollama.plist), runs /opt/homebrew/opt/ollama/bin/ollama
Only one server can listen on port 11434; whichever starts first after login wins, so the version you get can change at every restart. Keep one:
To keep Ollama.app 0.30.6: brew services stop ollama && brew uninstall ollama; then open /Applications/Ollama.app.

To keep Homebrew 0.34.2: quit Ollama.app (menu bar icon > Quit), remove it from System Settings > General > Login Items and move /Applications/Ollama.app to the Trash; then brew services restart ollama.

findings.title: Memory for the Recommended tier: needs 8.5 GB, 7.1 GB available now
lines: Available is free, inactive and speculative memory (3.0 GB) plus the models Ollama has loaded (4.1 GB); other apps use the rest.
Fix: close memory-heavy apps, or choose the Standard tier (needs 5.4 GB): agenthandover setup --vlm --tier standard

findings.title: Swap in use: 44.0 GB (more than 8.0 GB)
lines: The Mac is short of memory; the worker does not load the Skills model while this lasts.
Fix: close memory-heavy apps, or restart the Mac.
